title: Find Index of Element
description: Write a function `find_index_of(items, target)` that returns the zero-based index of the first occurrence of `target` in `items`. If `target` is not found, return `-1`.

hidden_tests.kind: target at the very last index

hints: Linear searching examines each element along with its numeric position.
Inspect how you iterate: Python lists are 0-indexed, so the first element is at index 0.
Make sure your function returns immediately as soon as the first match is found, not after checking the entire list.
If the loop finishes without finding any match, return -1 as the fallback.
Use 'for i in range(len(items)):' or 'for i, val in enumerate(items):' to track the current index.
